fc.title: First call speed
fc.help: What matters here: call every new order as fast as possible. Delay = from assignment (or arrival) to the first call; at night it counts from 9 am. On time = within {{first}} min, +5 min per newer order to call before it (newest first).

np.title: New orders of the period
np.help: Orders received in the period (creation date) or changed in the period (update date): how many are already handled, confirmed or cancelled.
np.confirmedSub: among the orders of the period

ec.title: Follow-up of orders in progress
ec.help: Orders already called but not confirmed yet: no answer, busy, call back, postponed. The date filter picks orders by creation or update date.
ec.countHelp: Orders already called but not confirmed yet: no answer, busy, call back or postponed. The DA value is the total of these orders.
ec.dueHelp: Orders in progress whose callback time has passed, or with no time set: call right away.
ec.lateHelp: Forgotten callbacks: more than 30 minutes past the planned time. Below, the order waiting the longest.
ec.lateNone: more than 30 min after the planned time
ec.laterHelp: Orders with a callback planned later (the customer asked to be called back). Below, the next callback.
ec.noAgentHelp: Orders in progress without an agent: nobody will call them back. Assign them to an agent.
ec.avgHelp: Average number of call attempts on orders in progress. The higher, the harder customers are to reach.
ec.manyHelp: Orders called 3 times or more without being confirmed. They may be cancelled: handle them first.
ec.oldHelp: Orders received more than 2 days ago and still not confirmed: they are dragging.
ec.rateHelp: Recovered divided by (recovered + lost). Lost = cancelled after at least 2 calls. Green from 60 %, orange 40–59 %, red below.
ec.empty: No order in progress for the period 🎉

cf.title: Confirmed orders
cf.help: Confirmed in the period, by order creation date or by confirmation date (update). Upsell = orders with a product added during the call or a quantity pack.
cf.upOrdersSub: product added or pack during the call
cf.upValueSub: extra sales thanks to the agent
cf.empty: No confirmed order in the period.

d.locked: Order already shipped: products cannot be changed.
d.merged: Same variant already in the order: quantities merged
d.addPh: + Add a product: type the name, colour or SKU…

focus.title: Confirmation
focus.auto: Go to the next one automatically
focus.none: No more orders to call for now 🎉

del.text: {{refs}} will be deleted for good with its history. Only orders not yet sent to the depot can be deleted.

kh.waiting: New orders not called yet (status “New” or “To check”, no attempt). “No agent” = nobody is in charge: assign them quickly.
kh.late: Orders not called yet whose deadline has passed: {{first}} min after arrival (or assignment), plus 5 min per newer order. Night time counts from 9 am. Call them now.
kh.oldest: The order waiting longest for its first call, with its reference and customer. This number should stay small.
kh.onTime: Among orders whose first call was made between the chosen dates: the share called within the deadline ({{first}} min, +5 min per newer order). Good above 80 %.
kh.median: Time from an order’s arrival (or assignment) to its first call: half of the orders were called faster than this. Night hours do not count.
kh.under5: Share of orders called for the first time less than 5 minutes after arriving, between the chosen dates. The higher, the more customers are reached while still keen.
